Since we last met

Four things went from idea to live.

Fuel Savings

A fuel programme for Standard Bank Fleet: every card fill-up checked against the truck's tank, and every missed discount found.

Driver app

Clock-in with a personal PIN and an evidence photo. Pre-trip inspections, SOS and fuel and rest stops, on the driver's own phone.

Car Guard

The owner's own iPhone app: arm when parked, an alarm on the lock screen if anyone starts, moves or tows the vehicle.

Cold Chain

Temperature probes on every load, checked against the range the customer needs, with an excursion record that stands up.

All four run on one platform, one sign-in, one console. Each is switched on per client and billed on active vehicles.

Driver app · accountability

Every trip has a driver.

●  A personal PIN

Four digits, stored hashed, locked after repeated wrong tries. No shared logins.

●  An evidence photo at clock-in

The driver agrees first (POPIA). The phone checks a face is there; the photo stays private and is deleted after the retention period.

●  A shared tablet or their own phone

At the depot gate, or on the driver's own iPhone, paired once with a one-time code.

●  Trips link to the driver on the vehicle

Trips with no driver are listed for the fleet manager every day.

Mhare Tech × Standard Bank Fleet Management · 14

Built to be trusted

Privacy and control are part of the product.

Consent, in writing

Photo consent is shown, versioned and agreed before a driver's first photo. It can be withdrawn at any time, and the photos go with it.

Photos stay private

Stored outside the web, opened only through a signed-in review page, and deleted after the client's retention period.

Clients are separate

Each client's data is its own. The bank sees totals from clients who opted in, and nothing about named drivers.

PINs and lock-outs

Driver and owner PINs are stored hashed and lock after repeated wrong tries. Sign-in is protected against guessing.

A record of who did what

Reviews, consent changes and alarm actions are logged with the person and the time.

Switch on only what's bought

Each system is a switch per client. What is off does not appear, and its pages refuse.
